title: GKnow: Measuring the Entanglement of Gender Bias and Factual Gender

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating token probability distributions and probability gaps on gender-related benchmarks (GKnow, StereoSet, DiFair) using counterfactual prompt substitution. The study also employs mechanistic interpretability techniques, specifically circuit analysis (EAP-IG) and neuron ablation, to measure the entanglement of factual linguistic gender and stereotypical gender bias.
